title: Russian Fricatives
why_promising: Primary non-singing Russian read-speech production with 59 speakers in the manually corrected first recording session. The repository documents 198 sentence types, WAV+TextGrid files, MAUS preprocessing followed by manual correction of target-fricative boundaries in Praat, 17,287 extracted manually corrected target-fricative tokens, and metadata fields for sentence/interval identifiers, SAMPA, IPA, preceding/following sound, voicing, palatalization, sentence type, carrier position, and word position. The deposit also exposes metadata.zip, sentence_list.zip, Recording_1.zip, Recording_2.zip and processing archives, making this unusually rich for segment timing/context and fricative production.
open_question: SWISSUbase's usage contract prohibits redistribution to third parties and appears to require an authenticated/download agreement. Keep in review until file-level access is confirmed. If access is obtained, ingest only the manually corrected Recording_1 lineage (plus its metadata/sentence list); quarantine Recording_2 because its 18 second-session recordings are automatic-only. Preserve repository references/checksums rather than redistributing restricted originals.
